segments.t: Pick up Coming of Age from Ailee Farheart. The follow-up conversation is with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
Hand Coming of Age over to Rorian the Dayseeker.
Pick up Harmony in Balance from Rorian the Dayseeker. The kill count is 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
Work through Harmony in Balance at Juvenile Vuldren.
Hand Harmony in Balance over to Rorian the Dayseeker.
Pick up Infestation Investigation from Elatrell Featherlight. The kill count is 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
Work through Infestation Investigation at Pesky Cirrusfly.
Hand Infestation Investigation over to Elatrell Featherlight.
Pick up The Cirrusfly Queen from Elatrell Featherlight. Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.
Work through The Cirrusfly Queen at Cirrusfly Queen.
Hand The Cirrusfly Queen over to Elatrell Featherlight.
Pick up The Way of the Hunter from Rorian the Dayseeker. Open the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove and do what it asks.
Hand The Way of the Hunter over to Tai'ree Farsight.
Pick up Embracing the Elements from Rorian the Dayseeker. Inspect the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
Hand Embracing the Elements over to Windshaper Boro.
Pick up A Student of Nature from Rorian the Dayseeker. Open the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove and do what it asks.
Hand A Student of Nature over to Xyton Silverwind.
Pick up At Home in the Shadows from Rorian the Dayseeker. Open the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove and do what it asks.
Hand At Home in the Shadows over to Akeri Duskblade.
Pick up The Warrior's Path from Rorian the Dayseeker. Open the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower and do what it asks.
Hand The Warrior's Path over to Blademaster Ren.
Pick up Elemental Unrest from Rorian the Dayseeker. Continue the talk with Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.
Hand Elemental Unrest over to Yala Windwatcher.
Pick up The Gift of Skysight from Ventaari Brightwish. The item this step wants used is your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
Work through The Gift of Skysight at Elemental Convergence.
Hand The Gift of Skysight over to Ventaari Brightwish.
Pick up The Anchors of Zephras from Halaan Hawk-Eye. The follow-up conversation is with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.
Hand The Anchors of Zephras over to Halaan Hawk-Eye.
Pick up Falling With Style from Myriaal Mistwake. Make the jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
Work through Falling With Style at the objective.
Hand Falling With Style over to Rorian the Dayseeker.
Pick up Call of Earth from Windshaper Boro. Carry a Signet of Akir to Windshaper Boro.
Work through Call of Earth at Al'Aketh Convert.
Hand Call of Earth over to Windshaper Boro.
Pick up Agitators from Yala Windwatcher. The kill count is 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
Work through Agitators at Roiling Winds.
Hand Agitators over to Yala Windwatcher.
Pick up Return to Rorian from Yala Windwatcher. Carry word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.
Hand Return to Rorian over to Rorian the Dayseeker.
Pick up Aetheen of the Gales from Rorian the Dayseeker. The follow-up conversation is with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.
Hand Aetheen of the Gales over to Aetheen of the Gales.
Pick up Call of Earth from Windshaper Boro. Locate the Rise of Spirits and drink the Earth Sapta.
Hand Call of Earth over to Minor Manifestation of Earth.
Pick up Call of Earth from Minor Manifestation of Earth. Carry the Rough Quartz to Windshaper Boros in Thendal Grove.
Hand Call of Earth over to Windshaper Boro.
Pick up Foul Matriarch from Aetheen of the Gales. The kill count is 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.
Pick up Aggressive Encroachment from Valreaa Valewind. Bring back 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
Accept Harvesting Windstones from Dalia the Collector.
Pick up Al'Aketh Thugs from Hanaa Nightwind. The kill count is 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
Work through Foul Matriarch at Ursera Scavenger.
Work through Aggressive Encroachment at Scrawny Ursera.
Complete Harvesting Windstones.
Work through Al'Aketh Thugs at Al'Aketh Neophyte.
Hand Al'Aketh Thugs over to Hanaa Nightwind.
Hand Foul Matriarch over to Aetheen of the Gales.
Turn in Harvesting Windstones to Dalia the Collector.
Hand Aggressive Encroachment over to Valreaa Valewind.
Pick up The Adventurer from Aetheen of the Gales. Continue the talk with Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
Pick up The Next Step from Aetheen of the Gales. Check in with Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.
